The main takeaway from our work is that

there are two distinct cognitive and neural systems that underpin mathematical learning: one that evolved to represent approximate magnitudes and one that evolved to support explicit learning of quantitative concepts.
the development of mathematics depends on the interplay between domain-specific and domain-general systems, which in turn depend on both genetic and environmental influences.
